verdict.rationale: Skyvern's source is public in the GitHub repo (Skyvern-AI/skyvern), and its llms.txt describes it as an open-source platform. An independent HN commenter confirms it is AGPL3-licensed, an OSI-approved open license; that commenter's complaint that AGPL is a non-starter for their employer reflects license fit, not openness. Self-hosting via pip, Docker or Kubernetes further shows the server code is available to run and read. Missing for 10: a first-party license statement or LICENSE file cited in the evidence, and clarity on whether cloud-only features (e.g. proxies, Copilot) are included in the open-source code.
